body:
Reviewed PR #14 (riatzukiza/eta-mu): bind staged pr-context.md as canonical six-arg at both trusted callers (run-opencode-review-recovery.mjs supervisor and embedded final prepublication check), Muse pin bump to a9a62f0d, and new native-event origin-check step — plus associated tests, NBB extern fixture, sandbox wiring, and documentary evidence surfaces.

Deterministic evidence: summary.json result=success, exact_head=true, clean_checkout=true, all seven gates exit 0 with no errors; deterministic.log (3824 lines) shows all 14 test suites passing, 241/241 review-workflow tests including the new canonical staged-context suites (UTF8/present-empty positives; missing, EISDIR, invalid-UTF8, changed-bytes, absence, foreign-path, omitted-read, EOF, older-verifier refusals; two-child custody; final prepublication rebinding) and native event context suites (native bytes reach child; replaced valid UTF8 refuses before child; identical producer formatter is last step before child; forged-origin scenario exits 1 with no child spawn). Lint zero errors/warnings across all packages (info-level layering notes are pre-existing).

Complete input review: all 40 diff pages delivered and assessed; full pr-context.md (7585 bytes, sha256 a0c49057…) read to EOF before first stage note; summary.json and deterministic.log read to EOF.

Candidate findings: none. All named invariants (six-arg binding, origin authenticity via byte comparison, pin provenance, artifact checksum provenance, step ordering before child/publication) are enforced fail-closed and tested at real boundaries. Documentary surfaces (receipts, ledgers, evidence JSON, kanban appends) are append-only data with established schemas; historical JS-fixture paths in intermediate receipts are superseded by the NBB extern move and carry no executable surface; pre-existing receipt-river diagnostics in test output are retained historical noise, not this diff.

Confirmed findings: none. Review event: APPROVE.
